title: The global 'Hollows burned' counter read 2/11 at the end, even though only one of the eleven named Act 2 holds (Thornwold) was actually burned - the second increment came from burning the Hollow Throne itself, which is Act 3/Marrowgate content and not one of the eleven enumerated holds. The counter's denominator (/11) becomes slightly misleading once the throne is counted in the numerator.
